statement.p: Find the vertices and foci of the conic section \left(\frac{x - 2}{5}\right)^2 - \left(\frac{y - 4}{9}\right)^2 = 1
The foci are at F_1= (,) (left) and F_2=(,) (right)
Note: Write the vertices from left to right, in an increasing order, starting with the vertex with the lowest x-value.

static.solution:
{\left(\frac{x}{5}\right)}^{2}-{\left(\frac{y}{9}\right)}^{2}=1. For this hyperbola, a=5, b=9 and c=\sqrt{{5}^{2}+{9}^{2}}\approx 10.296.
Hence, the foci are at \left(10.296, 0\right) and \left(-10.296, 0\right)
and the vertices are at \left(5, 0\right) and \left(-5, 0\right).
Since the given hyperbola is obtained by translating the center of the hyperbola {\left(\frac{x}{5}\right)}^{2}-{\left(\frac{y}{9}\right)}^{2}=1 to the point \left( + 2, + 4\right),
the foci are at {F}_{1}=\left(10.296 + 2, 0 + 4\right)=\left(12.296, + 4\right) and {F}_{2}=\left(-10.296 + 2, 0 + 4\right)=\left(-8.296, + 4\right)
and the vertices are A=(5 + 2, 0 + 4)=(7, + 4) and {A}^{\prime }=(-5 + 2, 0 + 4)=(-3, + 4).
